newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER SAFAR TO JOIN SV SALZBURG.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER SAFAR TO JOIN SV SALZBURG.

text.p: Austrian champions SV Salzburg have agreed a deal with Budapest club Vasas for Hungarian international goalkeeper Szabolcs Safar.
"Both clubs have agreed on contract conditions. Everything has been settled," said Safar's agent Skender Fani on Wednesday.
Personal terms have yet to be finalised but the player was expected to sign for Salzburg shortly.
Safar, who has been capped six times by Hungary, had previously been linked with Porto, Roma and English premier league clubs West Ham and Everton.
The latter club had Safar on trial in a pre-season friendly earlier this month but decided not to sign him.
Fani said Safar had already undergone medical tests and was due to begin training in Salzburg on Thursday. 301844 GMT jul 97
